name: Kata Containers
description: OCI-compatible VM isolation that can drive QEMU, Cloud Hypervisor or Firecracker.
descriptionZh: 兼容 OCI 的 VM 级隔离，可驱动 QEMU、Cloud Hypervisor 或 Firecracker。
keyFact: Kata Containers is an Apache-2.0 project governed by the Open Infrastructure Foundation that delivers VM-level isolation with a container-like workflow; it supports three hypervisors — QEMU, Cloud Hypervisor and Firecracker — and is OCI/CRI compatible, but requires bare metal or nested virtualization.
keyFactZh: Kata Containers 是由 Open Infrastructure Foundation 治理的 Apache-2.0 项目，以类似容器的使用方式提供 VM 级隔离；它支持 QEMU、Cloud Hypervisor 与 Firecracker 三种 hypervisor，兼容 OCI/CRI，但需要裸金属或嵌套虚拟化环境。
